<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2262012_leave_1.leaverequestutils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>leaverequestutils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var leaverequestutils = Class.create();
leaverequestutils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

	balanceLeave: function() {
		var employee = this.getParameter("employee");
		var leaveType = this.getParameter("leave_type");
		var currentDays = this.getParameter("current_days");
		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_2262012_leave_1_user_leave_tracking");
		if(gr.get("employee_name", employee)) {
			var totalDays = gr.getValue(leaveType);
			var newDays = totalDays-currentDays;
			gr.setValue(leaveType, newDays);
			gr.update();
			return newDays.toString();
		}
		else {
			gr.newRecord();
			gr.setValue("employee_name", employee);
			var defaultDays = gr.getValue(leaveType);
			var newLeave = defaultDays-currentDays;
			gr.setValue(leaveType, newLeave);
			gr.insert();
			return newLeave.toString();
		}
